violated_contract: A select-all control over a filtered view must decide and toggle selection from the identity of the rows that view shows, not from the size of the whole selection. Comparing counts lets a row hidden by a search or date filter stand in for a visible row, so the control reports every visible row selected and clears the selection instead of selecting them.
canonical_prevention: Derive the selectable rows from the same filtered list the view renders and test membership by row id (`every(row => selected.has(row.id))`), never by comparing set sizes; cover a hidden prior selection with a test that presses the control and asserts the visible row's id is acted on.
